source_notes: As of 2025-2026 reporting, Crown LNG consistently states it expects to reach FID for the Kakinada GBS terminal in 2026 (first gas 2029), with construction starting 2026. GEM currently records FIDYear 2025 with FIDStatus Pre-FID, which appears to be a stale/optimistic target. FIDStatus remains Pre-FID. Note terminal is a gravity-based structure (GBSRU), not an FSRU; capacity 7.2 mtpa and ~$1bn cost are unchanged/corroborated.
